_comment: Lazaret custom taint spec. Copy to .lazaret-taint.json in your project root (auto-loaded) or pass with --taint-config. 'sources' and sink 'pattern' are regular expressions; 'sanitizer' names are exact call names (module.func or func). Valid categories: SQL injection, command injection, code injection, template injection, path traversal, server-side request forgery, open redirect, cross-site scripting.
